content:
maria: Morning team — ready to lock the engine/kernel + quant rollout for Thu 03:00 UTC window. TL;DR: canary (1%) Thu 03:00, 10% Thu 03:15, 100% Thu 04:00 if green. Need pins, release-note blurb, rollback thresholds. :calendar: :rocket:

aj: sounds good. which kernel build are we shipping? kernel 4.12.1-quant-opt?

maria: shipping kernel: engine-kernel@4.12.1 and quant bundle: quant-bundle@v2.5-q8. Pin TTL: 2h for sticky pins during cutover. Anyone object?

luka: quick FYI — staging ran perf smoke: p99 latency up +18% on a tiny subset of matmul-heavy traces. I put logs in the staging thread. Not blocking but flagged. I'm re-running perf with KV-cache warm.

deploybot: DeployBot: scheduled rollout created by @maria — rollout id R-7900001. Canary: 1% -> 10% -> 100%. Rollout window: 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC -> 04:30 UTC. Pins: engine-kernel@4.12.1 pinned on night-bucket for 2 hours.

nikhil: rollback criteria proposal: if p99 latency regresses >10% for 3 consecutive 5-min buckets OR error-rate >0.5% absolute increase OR memory OOMs in any instance, immediate revert to engine-kernel@4.12.0 and quant-bundle@v2.5-q7. Agree?

aj: agree on p99 & errors. For OOMs let's be conservative: 2 OOM hosts within 10 minutes -> rollback. Also we should enable auto-fallback to q7 if trace quality drops (drop in exact-match score >2%).

jen: Release notes stub for marketing/security: "Performance-tuned kernel 4.12.1 with reduced quantization overhead for smaller memory footprint. Expect latency improvements for general workloads; we are shipping q8 quant bundle as default, with q7 fallback." Want to add safe language about canary.

maria: please add a short "what to monitor" list to release notes: p99 latency, error-rate, memory OOMs, KV cache hit-rate, eval prompt set pass-rate.

aj: pin command for deploybot (I'll run at T-10m):
```
/deploybot pin engine-kernel@4.12.1 --scope=night-bucket --ttl=2h
/deploybot pin quant-bundle@v2.5-q8 --scope=night-bucket --ttl=2h
/deploybot start-rollout R-7900001 --canary=1% --stages=1,10,100 --guard=telemetry
```

luka: I'll watch staging perf and open a hotfix branch if we see the p99 drift continue. Tagging @aj for profiling.

deploybot: DeployBot: canary traffic shifted to engine-kernel@4.12.1 for 1% — rollout R-7900001. Telemetry gates enabled.

nikhil: Quick ops checklist: have oncall watch channel eng-runtime, ensure runbooks linked, escalate to oncall if rollback triggers. I'm on PTO but I'll be reachable on call chain.

maria: ok let's do strict gating: if any guard trips -> auto-hold at current stage and send alerts in this thread. I will be primary release lead; @aj second. @luka you're QA owner.

jen: added release-note blurb to doc, pushed to /docs/releases/7900001.md. ping me if wording needs tweaks.

aj: I'm going to pre-load binaries on canary hosts (bake) and kick off a tiny VM-level smoke: `./bake.sh engine-kernel@4.12.1` — will post results.

luka: smoke: matmul microbench looks normal after warm KV; p99 now +5% (was 18%). continuing observation.

maria: thanks. If all green at 03:20UTC, we proceed to 10%. If anything flaps, we pin back and rollback per criteria.

deploybot: DeployBot: stage advanced to 10% — rollout R-7900001. Telemetry: p99=+3%, errors steady.

nikhil: monitoring: p99 stable, no OOMs, error-rate +0.02% -> within tolerance. marking green so far.

aj: starting the A/B eval suite now, will report pass/fail with exact-match scores in 5m.

luka: observed slight KV warm bias: initial requests show higher latency until cache warmed. Might need a short pre-warm at region-level next time.

maria: noted for postmortem. final checklist: post-release note, update changelog, unpin after TTL expiry or manually unpin at 05:00UTC. I'll cancel manual unpin only if we need more hold.

jen: sending out a short customer-facing note ready for 05:15 UTC.

maria: thanks all. I'll call handoff at 05:30UTC. :white_check_mark:
